name: CreateReplyDraft
description: Creates (or replaces, while still ממתין) the one reply draft for an InboundEmails row in Approvals: kind מענה ללקוח, recipient = the original sender, fromMailbox = the mailbox it arrived in, draftedBy מאיה, status ממתין, signed in the owning bookkeeper's name (added here, from the data). Rules enforced here: a PDF attachment or a כרטסת / חובות פתוחים reply is refused unless senderVerification is מאומת. Sets the email's status to טיוטה מוכנה. There is no send: approval (DecideApproval) stops at אושר – לא נשלח.

body.description: Hebrew reply body without signature (the signature is added from the data)

reason.description: Why Maya proposes this reply, from the data
